milestone: Agent 1 comprehensive benchmark evaluation — supplementary safe-isolated write diagnostic (Track S, not primary)

terminology.annotation_recall/precision: computed against frozen author-curated development annotations; not independently established application ground truth
terminology.session_conditioned: ACG roles are cookie-name session contexts, not semantic authorization roles
terminology.track_b: NOT MEASURABLE: without independent capability ground truth, the percentage of this application's functionality that Agent 1 captured cannot be established. Discovery counts are inventories, not coverage percentages.

protocol_deviations.what: First launch of the primary run was refused by the harness freeze guard because the operator wrote the driver log inside agent1/ (an untracked file counts as an uncommitted change).
protocol_deviations.effect: No trial ran. The log was moved outside agent1/ and the run was relaunched at 22:45:56 at revision 74426ce.

protocol_deviations.what: The host ran on battery (15% falling to 4%) and entered clamshell/maintenance sleep from 23:57:12. On macOS the monotonic clock pauses during sleep, so the agent's 180 s budget and the harness hard limits did not advance while asleep.
protocol_deviations.effect: SiyuCMS trials 0 and 1 were mapped across sleep intervals (measured wall time minus agent clock: 1526.5 s and 3602.0 s). Both are kept, flagged host_sleep_affected, and not rerun. `caffeinate -i` (infrastructure only) was added at ~00:25 but cannot prevent clamshell sleep. At 01:32:53 the driver was paused at a clean boundary (after SiyuCMS trial 1 was recorded, during trial 2 container setup, before any mapping; trial_2 directory empty; teardown exit 0, no residual containers). It resumed automatically on AC power at 12:37:58 under `caffeinate -i -s`, with the same revision and frozen agent tree. All other 49 primary trials show no wall-vs-agent-clock gap above 5 s. The three whiteboard trials (23:58) ran in brief dark-wake windows and show no measurable gap.

protocol_deviations.what: Preregistration revision 1 (section 5) disclosed ~32-minute SiyuCMS reset-verification cycles of unknown cause. The power log shows the host was sleeping from 16:00; the delay was host sleep, not reset logic.

Preregistration section 3 states the preflight did not exercise the stricter WebSocket scope enforcement because phase2_lab opens only same-origin sockets. phase2_lab deliberately also attempts an out-of-scope WebSocket (another loopback port). In scored runs the capture refused it 15 times per trial.
protocol_deviations.effect: The refusals are correct scope enforcement; with capture off the browser would have attempted that out-of-scope connection. Reported as a capture-on behaviour difference.

protocol_deviations.what: The supplementary write diagnostic passed allow_post_forms twice to RunConfig; all 9 Track S trials raised TypeError before the agent started (no browser, no mapping).
protocol_deviations.effect: Failed records preserved (agent1/experiments/comprehensive_post_diagnostic_failed_launch_1, git-ignored). Fixed in 4a4f819 (config merged into one dict; primary configuration byte-identical, asserted by a test); Track S was then run once at that revision. Primary data unaffected.

protocol_deviations.what: The preregistered readiness rule accepts any HTTP status < 500 at the application root. JetLinks answered 404 at the root after ~44-47 s of startup in all three trials, and the agent mapped that 404 page.
protocol_deviations.effect: JetLinks results reflect the 404 root. Whether the application was still initializing or serves no page at its root cannot be determined without inspecting the target, which the evaluation-only protocol forbids. No rerun.

protocol_deviations.what: The run log prints reference=None for surface, transfer and crawl-testbed reference kinds (the log looks up annotation keys only).
protocol_deviations.effect: None; trial.json records the full reference results.

protocol_deviations.what: The preregistered terminated_by field checks the action, transition and total-time budgets only. It cannot see the exploration time reserve (replay_reserve_fraction 0.30: exploration stops at ~126 s of 180 s and the rest is replay). Runs that stopped exploring at the reserve but finished replay early were labelled 'frontier_exhausted_or_other'.
protocol_deviations.effect: Added a measured, additive descriptive field per trial (exploration_ended_s, exploration_stop) from the agent's own transition timestamps. No score, threshold or reference metric changed. Corrected labels: heldout_shop, restoration_lab, crawlground, white-jotter and siyucms trial 2 stopped exploring at the time reserve; SiyuCMS trials 0-1 cannot be classified (host sleep).

protocol_deviations.what: During the supplementary Track S run the host returned to battery power and maintenance/clamshell sleep (power log 13:13 onward).
protocol_deviations.effect: Track S trials with a wall-vs-agent-clock gap above 5 s are flagged host_sleep_affected in agent1_post_diagnostic_summary.json. Track S uses in-process fixtures only (no external server clock), the agent budget is monotonic, and the affected heldout_shop trials reproduced the unaffected trial (17 capabilities; 309-311 actions). Not paused, not rerun. Primary data unaffected.
